name: Jotform AI Agents
task: Website or Shopify chat & FAQ deflection
summary: Build AI chatbots and customer-service agents in minutes — no code required. Handles leads, support tickets and bookings 24/7. Integrates with your existing forms and CRMs.
best_for: teams already using Jotform (or wanting no-code) that need AI chatbots and service agents to handle leads, support and bookings tied to their forms
skip_if: you need a deeply customizable, standalone conversational-AI platform, or your conversation volume would make the per-tier caps expensive
honest_knock: The gating detail is conversations, not features — Starter's 100 a month is a few days on a live site, and an agent that actually gets used will push you up a tier. Sessions are metered separately and Jotform counts a chatbot view or a page refresh as one, so a busy page burns allowance without ever holding a conversation; voice minutes and SMS meter on top as well. It's also tightly bound to the Jotform ecosystem: brilliant if you already live in Jotform forms, less compelling as a standalone chatbot if you don't. For form-driven support and lead capture, it's a fast, low-code win.

pricing.plans_source: hand-curated from the vendor's pricing page
pricing.notes: (re-verified 24 Sep 2026 on jotform.com/ai/agents/pricing from the plan data embedded in the page, and 4 Sep 2026 on the yearly tab; the same figures were read from a US exit on 26 Aug 2026. The page localises its currency — it quotes $34 / $39 / $99 to a US visitor and €34 / €39 / €99 to a Dutch one, the same numerals either way.) Starter is free. Bronze is $34 a month, Silver $39 and Gold $99, each billed annually, with 'save up to 20%' against monthly billing; Enterprise is quoted. On the AI Agents page the ladder is drawn in agents and conversations, not in forms and submissions: 5 agents and 100 monthly conversations on Starter, 25 and 1,000 on Bronze, 50 and 2,500 on Silver, 100 and 10,000 on Gold. Sessions, voice-call minutes, SMS and knowledge-base characters are metered alongside — 10,000 / 100,000 / 1,000,000 / 2,000,000 monthly sessions and 50 / 100 / 200 / 300 voice minutes across the same four tiers. Jotform defines a session as a chatbot view, a page refresh or a phone call starting, whether or not anyone interacts. The same plan data, read from a Netherlands exit on 24 Sep 2026, gives the annual totals as 408, 468 and 1,188 and the month-to-month rates as 39, 49 and 129 (in euros there), so monthly billing costs about 15% more on Bronze, 26% on Silver and 30% on Gold. Conversations count chat and phone alike, and the voice-call limit is shared between voice calls and calls to a dedicated phone number, which is a separate add-on (also available on Starter) whose price the served page does not print. Per the FAQ: a 30-day money-back guarantee from the date of payment; seasonal discounts apply only when upgrading to a higher-tier yearly plan and renew at full price the next period; upgrades are prorated and immediate, and a downgrade takes effect immediately with the unused time kept as account balance.

vendor_mcp.what: Server at mcp.jotform.com: create forms and read submissions, with an OAuth consent screen per user.
vendor_mcp.plan: Their own FAQ answers it: "Is the MCP free? Yes, the MCP server is available at no additional charge. Your existing Jotform plan limits and features remain in effect." Enterprise adds higher rate limits (up to 600 requests a minute), white-labelling of the MCP App and SSO.
vendor_mcp.note: The vendor's own MCP server, from our MCP research; it works with your own account at the vendor.
